The SKS is actually a much better and more accurate 7.62x39 rifle than its more popular AK rifle.

Reason:

The SKS was designed AS an semi-auto rifle.

The AK was designed as a full-auto and then converted to semi-auto for the civilian market.

The main concern has to do with tolerances.

The AK tolerances are very loose fitting in order to accommodate the fast cycling (600 rounds per minute)

While the loose tolerances help keep the firearm operating flawlessly even when overheated or full of dirt (sand)

They lend greatly to inacuracy.

With my SKS on the other hand, I can pop 30 head sized balloons with 30 rounds at 100 yards with the stock iron sights.

I've never been able to match that with my AK
